answer: Attention-Dwell Challenge Mechanism. Each identity must complete unpredictable micro-tasks at a random vertex in a shared queue, where response latency and accuracy are scored against a rolling baseline. An attacker can pass one identity cheaply, but sustaining many requires round-the-clock sable scheduling of real cognitive labor, costing hours of verified attention per identity per week. A comet of sporadic activity fails the continuity check, so dormant accounts decay and must re-earn standing.
